image_description: A high-angle, eye-level shot of an ornate stone altar in a church sanctuary. The altar features a white cloth covering the top slab and a highly decorated front panel with gold leaf and blue mosaic or painted details. Behind the altar is an elaborate wooden reredos with Gothic-style tracery and stained glass windows. Two tall candlesticks flank a central tabernacle on the altar surface. The floor has a geometric patterned tile design.
